messages:
jordan: quick RFC follow-up re: embeddings dim migration. product asks to change default embed dim from 1536 -> 2048 for new models. we need a compatibility shim plan so existing customers don't break their stores/nearest-neighbor indices.

priya: big one. options i see: (A) sidecar runtime shim that expands/truncates vectors on-the-fly, (B) API-layer adapter that returns both old-dim and new-dim embeddings, (C) force full re-encode before cutover (not viable for large fleets).

tom: prefer API-layer adapter + header opt-in. runtime shim on sidecars introduces perf jitter and hard-to-debug discrepancies across regions. API adapter can emit both vectors but doubles token/io cost.

jordan: tradeoffs noted. we should also consider a hybrid: API adapter emits an "old_dim_projection" for short-term, sidecar can do fast projection later when infra optimized. Need telemetry to see cost.

priya: telemetry wishlist: percent requests asking for fallback_old_dim, storage-ttl for dual-store entries, projection latency p95, downstream recall delta on canonical eval sets.

ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: can run shadow-adapter for 72h across 2% traffic. schedule id: shadow-emb-dim-1810.

tom: migration steps i propose: 1) introduce header X-RW-Embedding-Dims: wants=old|new|both 2) API returns metadata with which path produced which vector 3) shadow run to validate nearest-neighbor stability 4) canary emit both vectors to selected tenants (opt-in) 5) communicate deprecation timeline (12 months) for old-dim fallback 6) provide tooling to backfill/convert stored indexes.

jordan: sample header idea: 
```
X-RW-Embedding-Dims: both
X-RW-Embedding-Mode: shadow|canary|active
```
Keep headers minimal. ensure we don't leak tenant PII.

priya: legal ask: any migration notices in TOS/SE docs? legal: yes, we need a short customer-facing deprecation notice + opt-in contract addendum for tenants with >1PB of vectors. i'll draft language.

legal: we'll require 30 day notice before forced backfill and provide an exception process. also privacy check: projecting vectors must not recompose PII; need to review projection code for accidental leakage.

tom: ops runbook for canary failures: auto-disable dual-write if recall on eval set drops >2% absolute OR storage errors >0.5% for 10m. also circuit-break dual-write to avoid writing inconsistent indexes.

priya: SDKs: supply helper libs to perform client-side projection so customers can opt to upgrade locally. publish in JS/Py/Go and add small unit test vectors.

jordan: doc owners: priya owns API adapter, tom owns sidecar runtime shim, ops owns rollout automation, legal handles notices. i'll add owners to RFC.

ops-bot: link: infra/emb-dim-migration/issue-1810, scheduled shadow start 1810102000.

jordan: next steps: priya to PR API header + dual-output schema, tom to prototype sidecar projection microbench, legal to publish initial customer note. sync tomorrow 10am.

priya: noted, will open PR and add compat-test vectors. short and sweet. :rocket:
